title: Better GitHub
summary: A GitHub client for phones and tablets, built for reviewing.
description:
Better GitHub is an Android app (Tauri and React) for the parts of GitHub you do away from a desk: reviewing pull requests, checking builds, reading code.

This spec says what the app is meant to do. It covers:
- what a reviewer sees in a pull request
- what a repository's screens show, including this spec browser
- the rules the whole app keeps, such as where the token lives
